preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**9 and 1 <= k <= 10**18 for n, k in tests)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is between 1 and 10^9, and k is between 1 and 10^18.
The number of test case lines matches t.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((line.startswith('YES') or line.startswith('NO')) and (line.startswith('YES') and len(line.split()) == 2) or (line.startswith('NO') and len(line.split()) == 1) for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by a single integer.

postconditions.expression: all((k <= 2**n - 1 and (n - (2**n - 1 - k).bit_length() + 1) >= 0) or (k > 2**n - 1) == (line.startswith('NO')) for (n, k), line in zip(tests, stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: For each test case (n, k), if k > 2^n - 1, output is NO; otherwise, output is YES with the log2 of the side length being n - (2^n - 1 - k).bit_length() + 1, which represents the maximum possible side length for the path after exactly k splits.

postconditions.expression: all((line.startswith('YES') and int(line.split()[1]) == n - (2**n - 1 - k).bit_length() + 1) or (line.startswith('NO')) for (n, k), line in zip(tests, stdout_lines))
postconditions.description: When output is YES, the second token is the correct log2 of the side length of the squares on the path.
